name: emu-pager-screens
description: A Virtual Pager (SSD1680 250x122 e-paper) node named Pat on the ether with two named neighbors, Bob and Carol (OLED Heltec binary), all on one net key. Pat is the only e-paper node so the pager-screens e2e capture resolves it by its epaper-canvas; the neighbors are OLED so they add no ambiguous e-paper panel. The neighbors beacon at de-phased intervals (2.6s and 4.1s against the captured node's 3s: equal intervals phase-lock into repeated collisions at the equidistant captured node, and near-equal ones drift slowly enough to sit inside its own-TX half-duplex deaf window for many consecutive beacons; several hundred ms of relative drift per cycle bounds consecutive losses to one or two) so Pat's Nodes screen shows real peers with names and signal, and all three drive traffic so Pat's Messages screen shows a real conversation: Pat broadcasts HELLO PAGER, Bob broadcasts BOB HERE, Carol broadcasts ON MY WAY, and Pat sends a PING TEAM DM to a neighbor. All sends finish inside the first ~16s; the capture spec settles past that before the button-driven walk (Main / Messages / Nodes / Stats / GPS / Settings), and because it presses a button at every step (keeping the UI idle timer below the message-auto-switch threshold) no late arrival yanks the screen mid-walk. This is the e-paper analogue of emu-heltec-oled.json, inverted (captured node is the e-paper, neighbors are OLED). Build both binaries first: make -C emulator node (pager) and emulator/scripts/build_node_heltec.sh (OLED neighbors).
